 Idahoans have received a record $254.8 million in grocery tax refunds for 2025, up sharply from the $205.2 million returned the year before. The increase comes after lawmakers raised the annual credit, even as separate proposals to remove the sales tax on groceries entirely failed to advance.
 Find out how Idaho’s grocery tax credit works now and how the state compares with the handful of others that still tax food .
 Idaho abortion ban returns to full effect during appeal 
 A federal appeals court has restored full enforcement of Idaho’s abortion restrictions while litigation over the law continues. The Ninth Circuit majority said Idaho has a strong interest in enforcing its law and is likely to prevail in its appeal, while a dissenting judge argued constitutional protections for health-preserving abortions may still remain after Dobbs.  Damaged Caldwell overpass jumps to top of ITD’s priority list 
 After a semi strike forced the closure of the U.S. 20/26 bridge near Caldwell, ITD is fast-tracking its replacement and installing temporary signals to manage the resulting traffic problems. Officials say the bridge design could be finished by spring 2027, with demolition potentially beginning this winter and construction following soon after. Pasted markdown
